描述_EN: eight celestial dragons, four-clawed, chasing flaming pearls through the clouds, amid which bats (fu, homonyms for happiness) are flitting. child's robe of red silk satin, embroidered with coloured silks and gold thread. lined with pale blue silk damask (floral pattern). below is meru, the sacred mountain of the buddhists, rising from the waves. a piece of red satin has been glued to one corner, where the jacket was defective and this is decorated with applied pieces of silk embroidery.
描述_ZN: 八条天龙，四只爪子，在云层中追逐着火红的珍珠，其中有蝙蝠（fu，幸福的同义词）在飞舞。 红色丝缎的儿童袍，用彩色丝绸和金线刺绣。 内有淡蓝色的丝绸大马士革（花纹）。 下面是梅鲁，佛教徒的圣山，从波浪中升起。 一块红色的缎子被粘在一个角落里，那里是外套的缺陷，这是用应用的丝绸刺绣的碎片装饰的。
